notes.title: Update 0.197
notes.notes:
New Features:

 Core Virtues: Four new skillable core virtues have been added, enhancing health, damage, shield, and speed.
 Custom Input: You can now set custom input buttons for keyboard and gamepad controls.
 Enemy Variety: Several new enemy types have been introduced.
 Map Layouts: Map layouts have been reworked for improved gameplay flow.
 Quest Indicator: A visual quest indicator has been added for better navigation.
 Object Restoration: Gain the ability to restore damaged objects in the environment.
 Animal Handling: Acquire ingredients from animals without harming them.
 Magnetic Field: Collect items effortlessly with a magnetic field ability.
 Restorative Healing: Automatically heal when you remain stationary.
 Charged Spells: Charge your spells while walking for increased potency.
 Independent Aiming: Shoot spells in any direction, regardless of your movement.
 Keyboard Key Display: See the relevant keys displayed when playing with a keyboard.
 Ultimate Spell: The ultimate ability is now a spell that requires activation.
 Auto-fire Option: Activate auto-fire for your spells (reduces wizard spell damage by 25%).
 Auto-aim Option: Activate auto-aim for your spells (reduces wizard spell damage by 25%).
 Sound Volume Control: Adjust the sound volume to your preference.
 Item and Potion Slots: Unlock item and potion slots using your wizard level and gold.
 Item and Potion Charges: Items and potions now have charges instead of real-time expiration. Items can be recharged, but potions cannot.
 Euphoria System: Euphoria no longer expires in real time. Gain 2% power per quest and bonus quest.
 Ultimate Form VFX: New visual effects enhance your ultimate form.
 Destructible Environment: More world objects are now destructible.
 Southern Route: Added a southern route on Map 1.
 Map Rework: Map 4 (Hell of Hatred) has been significantly reworked.

Changes:

 Mastery Rework: Masteries have been redesigned for improved balance and effectiveness.
 Discomfort: Reduces the required number of kills during a run.
 Lifestyle: Increases the effects of all temporary items.
 Attachments: Increases the area of magnetic pull for items and gold.
 Harmony: Increases the area within which you can restore nature objects.
 Respect: Increases the effective area of animal handling.
 Meditation: Increases the healing effect when resting.
 Time Training Removed: The Time Training feature has been removed.
 Item Sales: Items that don't match your wizard magic type can now be sold.
 SteamDeck: Is now supported

Important Notes:

 Storage Rework: The storage system has been reworked, resulting in a progress reset.

Bug Fixes:

 Several bug fixes have been implemented to improve overall game stability and performance.
